name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes the routine (paint a runtime_char facing sprite at its battle-world position, with a selectable render mode). No Ghidra address residue. Cleanly distinguishes from the workspace-only sibling fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos @ 0x127E0; the '_with_mode' suffix marks the mode-aware variant. All 3 callers use it exactly this way.
purpose: Paint one runtime_char's facing sprite onto a caller-supplied surface at its battle-world position, choosing between a normal passthrough blit and a solid-color silhouette overlay (heal / status-effect highlight).
logic_summary: pchar = runtime_char_array[char_idx]; read pos_x/pos_y/facing(sprite_state[1]). Window-cull against the battle view window with inclusive +/-1 margins (4 early returns). Compute per-facing sub-pixel x_offset (0->stride<<2, 1->-4, 2->-(stride)<<2, 3->+4). Pick animation frame: walk_phase(sprite_state[2])==0 -> chapter ambient palette idx else chapter walk-anim alt palette idx; fold frame==3 -> 1. Resolve rle_stream from portrait_sprite_cache via sprite_idx = facing*3 + sprite_state[0]*0xC + frame (cache base + *(int32*)(base + idx*4)). dst = dst_buf - dst_stride*6 + (pos_y-origin_y)*dst_stride*0x18 + (pos_x-origin_x)*0x18 + walk_phase*x_offset. Mode dispatch: 0 -> fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(rle_stream,dst,dst_stride); 2 -> fd2_tile_blit_24x24_solid_color(rle_stream,dst,dst_stride,color); other modes draw nothing. No BIOS-tick shake jitter and no sleep handling (unlike the workspace sibling).
signature: void fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_with_mode(uint32 dst_buf, uint32 dst_stride, uint32 char_idx, uint32 mode, uint32 color)

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination surface base address. Callers pass either the render workspace (large_game_state_buffer + 0x8088, stride 456) or the mode13h primary surface (0xA0504, stride 320).
params.reason: Accurate; names the destination buffer base. No address residue.

params.name: dst_stride
params.semantics: Row stride of the destination surface (0x1C8=456 for workspace, 0x140=320 for primary). Also drives the facing 0/2 sub-pixel x_offset (stride<<2) and the dst row term (pos_y delta * stride * 0x18).
params.reason: Accurate; names the destination row stride. No address residue. (Live Ghidra mislabels this param 'stride' on the wrong slot, but the src name is already correct.)

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the runtime_char whose sprite is painted.
params.reason: Accurate; names the runtime_char array index. No address residue.

params.name: mode
params.semantics: Render mode selector: 0 = normal passthrough blit; 2 = solid-color silhouette overlay (heal / status-effect highlight); other values draw nothing. Callers pass 2 for the highlight frame and 0 for the normal frame.
params.reason: Accurate; names the render-mode dispatch selector. No address residue.

params.name: color
params.semantics: Silhouette color for mode 2 (callers pass 0xFD); ignored by mode 0 (callers pass 0). Forwarded verbatim as the 4th arg to fd2_tile_blit_24x24_solid_color (which actually derives its color from its stride arg & 0xFF and ignores this 4th slot, but the original still pushes it).
params.reason: Accurate; names the silhouette color used by mode 2. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; the routine either blits the sprite into dst or returns early on window-cull / unhandled mode.

notes: Source comment block (rndscene.c lines 549-605) is comprehensive, accurate, and matches decompilation precisely (window cull, facing x_offsets, frame fold, dst formula with dst_stride, mode dispatch, mode-2 color-from-stride note). No edit needed. Ghidra plate (Chinese) is consistent with the refined understanding - not stale/contradictory - so left untouched. All 5 params verified against 3 call sites (fd2_ai_pass_turn_with_heal x2: mode=2/color=0xfd then mode=0/color=0; fd2_run_full_turn_cycle x2: same; fd2_animate_attack_hit_sequence: mode=2/color=0xfd attack pose then mode=0 idle, using 0xA0504/320 direct primary surface). struct runtime_char.sprite_state[3] documented as [0]=cache_idx [1]=facing [2]=walk_phase in types.h, matching usage. Logic equivalence checked: facing==2 src '(0 - dst_stride) << 2' == asm 'x_offset=-param_2; x_offset<<=2'. No logic concerns. Live Ghidra param names (param_1..3, surface, stride) are auto-assigned and misordered but src names are already correct; no rename recorded since src is authority and already compliant.
